label: Account access failures
description: Reviewers report being locked out of accounts unexpectedly, unable to log in after updates, and experiencing account security issues like unauthorized access.

label: Premium paywall frustration
description: Reviewers complain that basic features have been restricted behind premium subscription requirements and express dissatisfaction with mandatory paid upgrades.

label: Missing songs and poor recommendations
description: Reviewers report songs disappearing from playlists and liked songs, while song suggestions lack variety and become repetitive.

label: Offline download problems
description: Reviewers struggle with downloading songs for offline listening, experience downloaded content being removed after updates or phone changes, and report storage management issues.

label: General app instability
description: Reviewers describe the app as buggy, unstable, and experiencing deterioration in overall performance and user experience.

label: Playback interruptions
description: Reviewers experience music stopping mid-playback, pauses between songs, false connectivity errors despite having internet, and difficulty playing songs uninterrupted.

label: Inadequate customer support
description: Reviewers report difficulty reaching support, unhelpful or dismissive customer service interactions, and inaccessible contact channels.

label: Excessive ads and restrictions
description: Reviewers complain about frequent ad interruptions, aggressive unskippable ads, and disabled shuffle forcing users toward premium subscriptions.
